title_original: 지방재정업무 처리를 위한 정보시스템의 관리ㆍ운영에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 7 (Commissioning Investigations and Research) Where the Minister of the Interior and Safety deems it necessary for the specialized operation or development of, or supplementation or improvements to, the Integrated Local Finance System, the Minister may commission relevant specialized institutions or experts to conduct investigations, analyses, research, or similar activities.
